$comment: Open TRIAL knobs for pure color-rule Night derive. NOT Wave product defaults. lightsLevel 1–5 = 月光/夜灯/晚间/烛光/晚霞. Warm scenes use Lab mix (cctWarmMix) toward amber pole — mild tint into cool charcoal, NOT absolute hue rotate to brown. Cool uses cctHueShiftDeg.cool. Accents stay 晚间-anchored.

trialTone.$comment: HCT tones: surface/container/text/neutral synced from scene; accent* (except accentMain dial) fixed at 晚间 L3 anchor; accentMain default 75 (Day/Night primary distance kept) — preview 「Primary Night 明度」can temporarily lower; scene apply preserves accentMain; accentOnMain is DYNAMIC from Night primary.main luminance (WCAG-ish T98/T21) — knob value is reflective; fine-edit absolute after scene apply.

chromaScale.$comment: Raise surface/neutral so Night keeps ink tint instead of ash; accent slightly >1 for pop.

chromaFloor.$comment: Day pastels/whites have near-zero chroma; floor prevents Night surfaces/accent-containers collapsing to mud-gray.

dayRoleOverrides.$comment: Sandbox experiment: Day primary* → Tailwind-like family before Night color-rule. Default cyan; preview segment also offers amber/teal/indigo/rose/olive/blue. Steps parallel prior mapping (600/50/600/100 for main/container/on-container/inverse).
